objective: Perform a fresh adversarial review of the complete v0.4 implementation, tests, integration, evidence, compatibility, and public claim boundary without editing repository files.
inputs: All targeted, regression, mutation, compatibility, integration, and evidence results
deliverable: An independent ACCEPT, ACCEPT_WITH_CAVEATS, REVISE, REPLAN, or STOP decision with prioritized evidence-backed findings.
read_scope: Entire adaptive-task-orchestrator repository at the final pre-review branch state
Git metadata required for status, history, and diff inspection

authoritative_facts: The approved v0.4 specification and ADR-0009 are the review authority.
The reviewer did not author V4-T1, V4-T2, V4-T3, or V4-T4 outputs.
Passing tests do not substitute for reviewing path containment, filesystem error handling, compatibility, or public claim boundaries.
Integrity remains relative to a trusted manifest and the quiescent-package model.
accepted_upstream_results: Accepted receipts and root checks for V4-T1@1, V4-T2@2, V4-T3@2, and V4-T4@2.
user_constraints: Read-only review; no historical mutation, dependency install, network, public push, tag, or release.
permissions: Inspect repository files and Git metadata and run read-only or automatically cleaned temporary-directory checks.
non_goals: Do not repair findings, rewrite evidence, broaden the approved version, or assess external authenticity.

acceptance_checks: Review specification conformance, path safety, deterministic failure behavior, filesystem error handling, read-only guarantees, and manifest completeness logic.
Review test quality for missing counterexamples, platform assumptions, weakened assertions, and false-positive GREEN behavior.
Review public API compatibility, CI portability and permissions, v0.2/v0.3 immutability, bilingual claims, and integrity-not-authenticity wording.
Reproduce decisive checks where practical and identify every missing or inconclusive required check.
Return no ACCEPT decision while any Critical or Required finding remains unresolved.
evidence_required: prioritized findings with file and line locations
final review decision and required next action
